text_content: View of Brainstorming Area: Interior, well-lit communal or learning space (likely an engineering/student innovation area). No people present. Main features: a cluster of small cube ottomans in three color rows (red, orange, yellow) arranged in a rectangular grid (about 12 cubes); a multi-tiered stepped seating platform with four visible stepped levels finished in wood and blue cushions; a long low bench in front of the steps with multiple teal cushions set on wooden supports; a countertop with under-cabinet storage/cupboards along the left/rear wall with small items on top (a dispenser or jug, a pump bottle, a small box or paper tray, and printed notices/signs above it); a double-panel glass entrance or partition on the right with posted notices; overhead recessed and panel lighting; vertical green decorative fins on a partial wall above the stepped seating; carpeted floor in the seating area and smoother flooring in the walkway to the left; various posted signs and safety/notice labels on the walls and doors. Architectural details: open ceiling elements and exposed ductwork, angled structural opening above the steps, and an adjoining corridor visible to the left. Overall scene: a clean, modern collaborative seating/meeting area designed for informal gatherings, presentations or student use.

Close up view of Makerspace: "Building P A G with Image D..." (partial slide text visible; remainder not fully legible): Interior of a modern collaborative workshop / makerspace or classroom. The room has large floor-to-ceiling windows along the right side with plants on the windowsill and an exterior view. The ceiling is exposed with visible ducting and numerous large rectangular recessed light panels; several black power/data cables hang down to the tables. There are multiple long wooden worktables (at least 6) arranged in rows, each with several stools (approximately a dozen visible stools). On the nearest and middle tables are multiple open laptops (at least 5 laptops visible). In the center/rear of the room is a large freestanding display/TV showing a presentation slide; a smaller computer monitor is visible on a desk to the right of that display. A whiteboard on a stand with handwritten notes is positioned near the right side of the room. Shelving and storage boxes, small electronics and equipment are visible along the back wall and near the windows. Several people (approximately 5–7) are gathered at the left/middle tables—faces are blurred and no individuals are identified. Other small items visible include power strips, cables, a few printed papers on the tables (one sheet visible on the nearest table), stools pushed under tables, and various desk accessories. The overall scene is an active collaborative workspace where a small group appears to be working or discussing around laptops and a presentation screen.

Peel Engineering Laboratory, 1934: A mounted, sepia/black-and-white historic photograph printed on a teal/blue informational panel. The photograph shows a two-story industrial or institutional building set back from a curved paved road. Features visible in the photo include: a long rectangular structure with a flat or low-pitched roof, multiple rectangular windows on both floors (approximately ten visible), a low stone or concrete boundary wall running along the road, a curved driveway or entrance in front of the building, and a tall narrow chimney stack or smokestack rising behind or to the right of the building. The surrounding display panel has a teal/green gradient background with faint large numerals and arc graphics overlaid, a thin white horizontal border near the bottom, and a small dark blue rectangular label to the lower right of the photograph. There are no people or vehicles visible in the historic photograph. The mounted photo shows some glare/reflection from lighting at the top. Overall scene: a historical exterior view of an engineering or industrial laboratory building reproduced on an exhibit or informational wall panel.

Wide view of the Brainstorming Area at Innowing: Indoor common / presentation area in a modern academic building (likely a foyer or small auditorium space). The scene includes: a large LED video wall on the far wall displaying a video (one person visible on the screen, face not identifiable); a white lectern/podium positioned in front of the video wall; a freestanding display board leaning against the wall to the right of the podium; a brass bell hung from the ceiling on the right wall with a green pull cord; a wall sign on the right that reads the location (see caption field); a mobile monitor on a wheeled stand at the right foreground showing a blue screen; a stepped wooden/teal bench/platform area on the left; three rows of colorful cube seats arranged in a grid (approximately 12 small cubes in 3 rows × 4 columns, colors include red, orange, yellow and green shades); a curved white table and a single chair visible in the bottom foreground; a glass-walled meeting room or office at the back-left with at least two chairs and a small table visible inside; carpeted presentation area immediately in front of the video wall and benches, surrounded by smooth blue flooring with tactile guiding strips embedded in the floor; exposed ceiling with visible HVAC ducts, piping and suspended light fixtures; an emergency exit sign above a doorway to the right of the video wall; small wall-mounted notices and a cabinet or shelving unit behind the glass partition. No people are physically present in the room (0 people standing or seated in the space). The overall scene looks like a university innovation or engineering common area set up for presentations, small events or informal gatherings.

Students conducted experiments in the Environment Biotechnology Laboratory, 1999: A busy laboratory bench scene with students performing an experiment. The image shows at least six people (several partially obscured) gathered around a long lab bench; faces are blurred or turned away. One person in the foreground is wearing a striped shirt with the word "ALASKA" visible. Another person at the right front is wearing a white lab coat. The bench contains typical wet-lab equipment and supplies: a blue hotplate or magnetic stirrer with a glass beaker containing a yellowish liquid being heated or stirred; a metal retort/clamp stand holding glassware; additional glass beakers and small glass vessels; plastic reagent bottles (one with a black cap and yellow/white label); several wash bottles and squeeze bottles; tubing (orange tubing and clear tubing) connected to fittings; a faucet/gooseneck spout assembly over a sink area in the foreground; a power strip/plugged-in electrical cable; a graduated cylinder or tall glass column at the left; papers, notebooks, and pens on the bench; a tray or box holding small items (possibly pipette tips or slides) and a folded paper towel. In the background along the wall are more reagent bottles and containers sitting on a shelf. The scene appears to be an instructional laboratory environment where multiple students are observing and handling glassware and solutions. The photograph is vertically oriented and includes a printed caption area at the bottom stating the location and year.

Visible captions and text on the display: "First Engineering Inno Show, 2019"; "Dedication Ceremony for Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing, 2018"; "Faculty of Engineering THE UNIVERSITY OF HONG KONG"; (a smaller caption at left partly visible) "Presentation Ceremony, 2017".: Photograph of a wall-mounted collage or poster made of three separate event photos stacked vertically, taken indoors at the Faculty of Engineering, The University of Hong Kong. Each panel shows a formal group photograph with many people wearing business attire (suits, ties, dresses), name badges and floral boutonnieres. Faces in the image are pixelated/blurred. Top panel: a medium-sized group (approx. 20–30 people) holding circular signs that say "WINNER"; a small black robot or machine is visible on the ground in front of them. Middle (largest) panel: a large formal group photo (approx. 25–35 people) posed on a stage with several seated in the front row and others standing behind; at least two people are seated in wheelchairs in the front row; rows of chairs and a backdrop banner with logos and text are visible; overhead recessed lights and a speaker are visible above the stage. Bottom panel: a smaller group photo (approx. 8–12 people) standing in front of a backdrop similar to the middle panel. Repeated visual elements across panels include the Faculty of Engineering logo, the text referencing the "Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing," printed sponsor logos, and event title banners. The overall scene is a celebratory/formal academic event (dedication/ceremony and show) captured as display photos on a wall. Additional visible details: tiled/brick-patterned floor in one panel, printed graphic artwork to the right of the middle panel, and small caption strips under some panels with event years.

Project Mingde: Outdoor scene showing a group of volunteers working on a small construction/landscaping project. Approximately 10–12 people are visible (most wearing wide-brim sun hats), several facing away or bent over while shoveling or carrying material; one person's face appears blurred. Activities include digging, shoveling, and moving soil with at least one visible wheelbarrow. Visible objects and details: 1 wheelbarrow, at least 3–4 shovels, 2–3 large piles of sand/soil, a partially built concrete block wall, the corner of a yellow-painted building at right, dense green trees in the background, and a partly cloudy sky. The photo is mounted on a teal poster/background with white curved lines. Clothing is casual (t-shirts, jeans, athletic shoes). Overall impression: a volunteer construction or community project taking place outdoors on a sunny/warm day.

Students took photo outside Ho Tung Engineering Workshop: A photographed printed poster or display panel showing a vintage group photo of five students standing and sitting on a low concrete wall outside a building. The five people are arranged along the wall: two are seated on the left part of the wall, three are standing/leaning toward the right. Faces in the image are blurred. Clothing suggests older/retro styles (bell-bottom or flared trousers, short-sleeve shirts): the rightmost person wears a red short-sleeve shirt and dark trousers, the center figures wear lighter shirts (grey/blue) and light-coloured trousers, and the leftmost figures wear darker tops and flared jeans. Visible objects and scene elements include the low concrete/stone wall they are sitting on, a paved walkway or sidewalk in the foreground, the building facade behind them with tall windows (vertical panes) and at least one small circular plaque or decorative element above a window. The printed panel has a turquoise/teal border and a visible glossy surface with slight glare/reflection. The overall scene is an outdoor campus or workshop exterior with a relaxed group pose. Estimated number of people: 5. No identifiable personal information is visible.

:Interior view of Makerspace: Interior view of a modern workshop / classroom / makerspace. The room contains multiple long rectangular wooden worktables arranged in rows (about 8–10 tables visible) with round wooden stools (approximately 18–24 stools visible) grouped around them. Several laptops are open on the tables (around 4–5 laptops). Two large flat-panel screens on stands are positioned along the right side of the room; one screen shows a presentation slide but the text is not fully legible. A flip chart/whiteboard on an easel is near the right side. Power strips and hanging power cords are attached to or suspended above several tables. Along the right wall there are cabinets and shelving, with windows above them letting in daylight. The far wall is mostly glass, creating a partition to another area; a corridor and additional rooms are visible beyond the glass. There are safety and informational signs on the left wall near an entrance. Five people are present: one person seated at a table on the left working on a laptop, a person in white standing near the glass partition in the rear, and a small group of about three people gathered around a table toward the center-back of the room collaborating. The floor is smooth and light-colored, the ceiling exposes ducting and lighting fixtures, and the overall scene looks clean, organized and set up for collaborative work or instruction. Several sheets of paper and small items are on some tables.

Drawing Office inside the Peel Engineering Laboratory: A museum or exhibit panel showing a large sepia or black-and-white historical photograph of an indoor drafting room. The photo fills the top portion of the panel and depicts a spacious drawing office with many large drafting tables or drawing boards arranged in long parallel rows that extend into the background. Several windows line the far wall, and overhead lighting is visible on the ceiling. There appear to be three people (silhouettes) working or walking among the tables in the mid- to background; individual features are not clear. The exhibit panel has a dark blue horizontal caption strip beneath the photo and a pale gray background with faint circular graphic elements. The bottom edge of the image shows a painted wall or ledge in a light turquoise/mint color with a small shadowed trim. Overall the scene is a historical, industrial/educational interior photograph displayed as part of an exhibit.

Surveying, 1951: A mounted, sepia-toned historical photograph displayed on a teal exhibit panel. The photograph itself appears to show an outdoor surveying scene from the mid-20th century. Visible in the photo are four men (three standing or squatting and one kneeling) dressed in light-colored clothing and hats. They are arranged across a cleared, possibly dirt or paved area with vegetation/tree-line in the background. Surveying tools and markers are visible: at least three long poles or rods, a few ropes or measuring lines stretched along the ground, and one man appears to be handling a small instrument or stake while another kneels and points towards the ground. The men wear wide-brimmed hats or caps and loose trousers consistent with period attire. The mounted print is inset on a teal graphic background; below and to the right of the photograph is a small dark-blue label with white text. The lower portion of the image shows the exhibit panel’s teal surface and a pale green ledge or shelf at the bottom edge. Overall scene: a museum or display panel showing a historical photograph of a land-surveying activity, with four people, multiple poles/rods (3+), and several measuring lines or ropes (2+). Faces are not identified.

The Duncan Sloss School of Engineering and Architecture, 1950: A sepia-toned historic photograph of a multi-story institutional building (mid-20th century style) taken from street level. The facade is rendered in stucco or plaster over masonry and shows three main stories plus an attic/roof dormer. The building has many rectangular, multi-pane casement windows arranged in rows across the facade (approximately 18–20 visible windows); several of the windows are open outward. On the left section of the facade there is painted signage reading part of "SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING & ARC..." and a small crest or emblem next to the text. A covered entrance/porch canopy is visible at the lower left. A low stone or masonry boundary wall runs along the base of the building in the foreground. A vertical rainwater downpipe is visible at the right corner of the building. The roof has an overhanging eave and a dormer with additional windows. The photograph contains no people or vehicles. The overall scene appears to be a historical campus or institutional building portrait, shown in a warm sepia tone. At the very bottom of the image there is a modern blue caption strip.

Site Visit to Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing, 2020: Indoor group photo taken in a modern institutional/office space (an innovation wing). Thirteen people are present: 6 seated (one of those seated is in a wheelchair) and 7 standing behind them. Faces in the photo are blurred. Most people are wearing business or business-casual clothing; one seated person is wearing a colorful patterned jacket. Several white safety helmets (hard hats) are visible — six appear on laps or held, and one is worn by a standing person at the far right (total seven visible). The seated people sit on simple red/orange chairs. The background shows glass partitions, white and blue geometric wall panels, overhead lighting, and a light grey floor. A wheelchair is visible in the front row at the right. There is a printed caption strip at the bottom of the image identifying the visit and year.

: Interior view of a modern multi-purpose lobby or student common area, photographed from an elevated vantage (balcony or mezzanine) looking down. No people are visible. Main identifiable items and features: a long lightweight model airplane (wooden framework with small wheels) suspended from the ceiling, spanning much of the central area; four white modular study tables on the carpeted area, each table accompanied by around 3–5 grey stackable chairs (approximately 15–20 chairs visible around tables); a stack of additional grey chairs piled near the right wall (about 8 chairs stacked). To the left and rear is a seating/step area with brightly colored rectangular bench cushions (a row of 4–6 blocks in red, orange, yellow and green tones). A large video wall or multi-screen display is mounted on the far wall with a small podium/lectern in front of it. Overhead the ceiling is exposed with visible metal ducts, piping and a scissor-style ceiling lift or hanging projector mount. Flooring changes from blue vinyl/tile in the circulation zone to carpet in the seating/study area. Walls have multiple posters, signs and informational boards; one noticeable sign near the rear reads something like an “...Innovation Wing / Faculty of Engineering” (text on signs is visible but partially small/unreadable). An exit door with a lighted EXIT sign is visible on the right wall. Small details: wall-mounted hand sanitizer or dispenser near the left, a trash bin, a freestanding TV or information screen on a stand near the rear right, and several small printed reservation/notice sheets placed on the tables. Overall scene suggests a university or institutional engineering/common area designed for study, informal events or displays.

: A wide view of Brainstorming Area:  / presentation space or informal auditorium inside a modern building. No people are visible. Key objects and features observed: - Seating: nine rectangular modular bench cubes arranged in a 3 x 3 grid (3 red in front row, 3 orange in middle row, 3 yellow in back row). - Tiered stepped seating at rear-left made of wood and blue upholstered cushions (about 4–5 stepped levels). - Long low countertop/cabinet along the left wall with a small appliance area: a water dispenser (or water boiler), a microwave or similar appliance, a kettle and small items on the counter. - Multiple posted safety/notice signs on the backsplash above the counter. - Trash bin near the left counter. - Freestanding sign holder/stand near the left foreground. - A white lectern/podium with a monitor or laptop on it, located on the right side of the room. - Large wall-mounted display or projection area to the right-back showing a screen with a purple frame and map-like content. - Glass partition or doors at the rear of the space leading to another room; small signs visible on the glass. - Ceiling: exposed ducts and conduits with several rectangular recessed lighting panels (visible overhead). - Floor surfaces: light blue vinyl or painted floor in the foreground with tactile metal strips, and a carpeted area in the seating/presentation zone. - A small bell hanging near the right doorway, and a long pole/ladder or mop leaning against the right wall. - An emergency exit sign above a doorway on the right. - General color scheme: pastel green overhang/beam across the center, blue accents on the tiered seating, and neutral cabinetry and carpet. Overall scene: a modern, open multi-use learning or meeting area set up for informal presentations or group activities, currently unoccupied.

First Engineering Inno Show, 2019: A printed photograph mounted on a larger display panel showing a large group celebration scene outdoors under a building overhang. The mounted photo is near the bottom of a display that has a red strip at the very top, a blue bar beneath it, pale grey panels with curved white line graphics, and a teal stripe at the right edge. The photo itself shows approximately 30–40 people (mostly adults) assembled on a brick-paved area; faces are present but some appear blurred in this capture. Many people are crouching or kneeling in front while others stand behind. At least eight people are holding round placards that read "WINNER" (several of these placards are visible across the front row and middle). A small wheeled robot or robotic vehicle is on the ground in front of the group with the number "33" visible on it. The setting in the photo appears to be an engineering or academic event outside a campus-type building — visible elements include brick walls, concrete pillars, a covered walkway, a blue tent or canopy to the left, and multi-story buildings in the background. Clothing ranges from casual to business casual. The overall scene is celebratory, suggesting an awards or competition photo (winners posing together). There are no clearly readable individual names in the visible area of the photo itself beyond the large "WINNER" text on placards.

Industrial training to Tsinghua University, 1994: A printed group photograph mounted on a teal exhibition panel. The photograph shows an outdoor scene in front of a large multi-storey institutional building with many windows, fabric awnings over the windows, Chinese-character signage above the entrance, and decorative architectural details. There are trees and lampposts visible to the right of the building. In the foreground of the photograph a group of roughly 18 people (appearing to be students or young adults) are posed for the picture: some standing in a row, several crouching or kneeling in front. Most wear casual clothing (T-shirts, shorts, jeans) and several have backpacks or bags placed nearby. Faces in the displayed photo are blurred. The printed photo is mounted on a teal display board with white grid lines; a small dark-blue label beneath the photo contains a caption. The lower portion of the overall image shows part of the exhibition surface (a light turquoise ledge or shelf) and a strip of grey carpet at the very bottom.

Establishment of Department of Computer Science, 1988: A photographed display of a full newspaper page mounted on a wall. The newspaper header reads "Hongkong Standard" with a large section title "Student Extra" across the top. The page is dated "TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 23, 1988." The main headline across the lower half of the page reads "New department for HKU." The page contains a large central photo showing an indoor computer lab or classroom filled with vintage desktop computers (CRT monitors, separate keyboards and tower/CPU units) and several people working at desks. Visible details in the photo: one person standing at left in a suit, and roughly three to four seated people clustered at computer stations (total people visible in the photo area: approximately 4–5). There are about six CRT monitors and associated keyboards/printers visible in the photograph. Below the large photo there is a block of article text in columns and a visible byline and short photo caption area (names and small printed lines are present but not transcribed here). To the right of the main photo is a vertical sidebar labeled "INSIDE TODAY" with a short list of news/study sections and a small inset photograph showing two people running (sports). The overall newspaper page has a warm, aged/newspaper-tone color. The page is shown above a rectangular blue label plaque mounted on the same surface.

Cheque Presentation Ceremony, 2017: Indoor formal presentation scene showing a group of six adults arranged for a photograph. Five people are standing across the back and one person is seated at the front (the seated person appears to be in a wheelchair). All visible faces are blurred in the image. The group is holding an oversized ceremonial cheque. Visible details on the cheque include: payee line 'The University of Hong Kong', numeric amount '$100,000,000.00', written amount 'HK Dollars One Hundred Million Only', a date that appears to read '29 12 2017', and a payer name that appears as 'Mrs May Tam'. The people are dressed in business or formal attire (suits, ties, a skirt and jacket). The setting appears to be an office or formal reception room with a wooden door, framed artwork on the wall, an area rug, and an upholstered armchair visible. There is a small framed sign on the right side of the scene that reads 'Lunch'. The photograph is mounted or printed on a larger panel which shows colored ceiling-like graphic elements (red and blue panels) at the top and a blue caption label at the bottom right.
